verdicts.title: Unitarizability in Corank Three for Classical p-adic Groups
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Let G be the F-points of a classical group defined over a p-adic field F of characteristic 0. We classify the irreducible unitarizable representation of G that are subquotients of the parabolic induction of cuspidal representations of Levi subgroup of corank at most 3 in G.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns classification of irreducible unitarizable representations of classical p-adic groups via parabolic induction ('classify the irreducible unitarizable representation of G that are subquotients of the parabolic induction'), which has no interaction with Selmer groups of elliptic curves or communication complexity rank variance.
